title: The Bullish Strangle Nobody Talks About Almost Doubles Your Return. 20 Years of SPY Data.
description:
This video examines bullish strangles as an effective options trading strategy, contrasting its performance and risk against alternatives like naked puts. Learn how bullish strangles can offer improved returns and downside protection, even with potential for higher volatility. The discussion emphasizes that this trading strategy is particularly well-suited for consistent market uptrends, providing solid returns through robust risk management.
